take: Seattle announced it has placed defenseman Ryan Lindgren on injured reserve. He has averaged 12:45 a night on the third pair and kills penalties, and Seattle has played five games without him already. In that stretch Ryker Evans has moved in beside Fleury and is up to 23:27 a night from 21:37, while Vince Dunn is up to 24:13 from 21:46. In Lindgren's four games, Seattle controlled 47 percent of the quality chances (expected goals) at five-on-five when he was on the ice, so the loss shows up mostly in who skates the extra minutes.
